rules.question: Where does the Preview's clock go when a fill is clicked?
rules.owner: PbApp::click_fill in src/pathbuilder/pb_window.cpp, which sets hover_return_ms_ for the timeline, the highway and a list row alike
rules.decision: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-31-path-builder-mockup-3/answers.md, bar question 7: a row click moves the Preview's clock to the fill, like a fill click; found by the SC-4a review
rules.note: Every way of clicking a fill ends in PbApp::click_fill, which parks the clock the hover returns to on the fill's span start. A caller that sets hover_return_ms_ to the fill's start before calling it is saying that a second time. The hover block's own writes (the position on entering, a band click's position) are different questions and do not match. A scope names a top folder or a single file (OwnerRule::scope), so the row lists each file under src/pathbuilder; a new file there joins the list.
